pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for.

path.description: The starting directory for the search. It must be located within the project path; the default is the current working directory.

include.description: An optional glob pattern used to filter files (e.g., '*.go' or '*.{js,ts}').

literal_text.description: If true, the pattern is treated as a literal string rather than a regular expression. The default value is false.
